run_agent_in_environment: run an agent in a gym or multi-agent environment and compute mean rewards over repetitions
create_step_outcome_from_multiagent: create StepOutcome objects from multi-agent step returns using from_multiagent_step class method
convert_outcomes_to_multiagent_step: convert a dict of StepOutcome objects back to ray-like multi-agent step format
create_partial_multiagent_env: create a PartialMultiAgentEnv by fixing some agents in a multi-agent environment
convert_to_single_agent_env: convert a PartialMultiAgentEnv with one remaining agent into a standard gym single-agent environment
